title: IMDO Master Brief — November 14, 2026

sections.title: Wars and Armed Conflicts

entries.title: Zelenskyy describes US Donbas-for-NATO suggestion
entries.development: Zelenskyy says US negotiators floated exchanging Ukrainian territorial concessions in Donbas for NATO membership.
entries.significance: A specific potential negotiating trade-off emerges beyond the previous reports of talks; no agreement is confirmed.
entries.uncertainty: This is Zelenskyy's characterization of a proposal, not an agreed US or NATO position.

entries.title: US president reportedly considers withholding new Iran strikes
entries.development: Reuters reports, citing sources, that Trump told advisers he may hold off further attacks on Iran absent new provocations.
entries.significance: A possible de-escalatory signal follows the recently reported Strait of Hormuz maritime incident.
entries.uncertainty: Private deliberations attributed to unnamed sources; no binding cessation order verified.

entries.title: Germany seeks predictability from US-Russia talks
entries.development: German Chancellor Merz urged Trump to avoid surprises in negotiations with Putin.
entries.significance: European allies are seeking influence over the security framework being negotiated.
entries.uncertainty: Diplomatic request does not establish a change in negotiating positions.

sections.shortfall: Fewer than five distinct verified conflict developments; no new sufficiently corroborated Sudan or Gaza item was selected.

sections.title: Sociopolitical Shifts

entries.title: Reuters examines grievances driving French unrest
entries.development: Reuters examines cost-of-living protest escalation, rioting and police tactics in France.
entries.significance: Adds on-the-ground context to the previously reported foreign disinformation amplification; protest origins and foreign narrative manipulation are distinct.
entries.uncertainty: Causal interpretation of policing and unrest remains contested.

entries.title: ASEAN summit tests regional cohesion amid energy crisis
entries.development: Reuters reports energy disruptions and regional conflicts are straining ASEAN unity ahead of its summit.
entries.significance: Regional economic stress and security disputes may shape diplomatic alignment.
entries.uncertainty: Potential summit outcomes remain forecasts, not decisions.

sections.shortfall: Only two sufficiently distinct verified sociopolitical developments were selected.

sections.title: NYC Affairs

entries.title: Mayor's office lists new street-safety announcement
entries.development: The NYC Mayor's Office lists a November 13 press conference on street safety.
entries.significance: Signals a potentially consequential transportation policy announcement requiring retrieval of the full statement.
entries.uncertainty: Specific measures and implementation dates were not independently established from the index.

entries.title: City releases November financial plan
entries.development: The Mayor's Office lists the November financial plan and says it reduces the budget gap while protecting services.
entries.significance: A new official fiscal update is relevant to public-service and housing program capacity.
entries.uncertainty: Detailed allocations were not verified in this edition.

entries.title: NYC publishes latest overdose mortality update
entries.development: The Mayor's Office says overdose deaths are at the lowest level since 2019, 58% below their 2022 peak.
entries.significance: An important public-health indicator for outreach and service planning.
entries.uncertainty: Underlying surveillance tables and methodology were not independently inspected.

sections.shortfall: Three verified official announcements; no additional distinct municipal measure confirmed.

sections.title: Occult Practice & Machine Intuition

entries.title: CausalSAGE refines partially identified causal graphs
entries.development: Researchers propose a method for refining partial ancestral graphs into candidate directed acyclic graphs using state-level representations and structural priors.
entries.significance: Pattern Sense could compare candidate causal orientations instead of treating uncertain arrows as facts.
entries.uncertainty: Research preprint and authors' benchmark results; older paper newly reviewed.

entries.title: CausalGuard calibrates causal effects across graph uncertainty
entries.development: Researchers propose structure-weighted conformal inference using candidate causal graphs and calibration.
entries.significance: Inference Engine could attach uncertainty intervals to conclusions dependent on uncertain causal structure.
entries.uncertainty: Preprint; coverage guarantees apply under stated statistical assumptions.

entries.title: Test-time Calibration Learning adapts confidence on new tasks
entries.development: Researchers propose label-free test-time adaptation of reasoning accuracy and expressed confidence and report improvements on benchmarks.
entries.significance: Second Sight could distinguish model self-confidence from independent verification and monitor calibration drift.
entries.uncertainty: Authors' reported results, not externally reproduced in IMDO.

sections.shortfall: Three distinct research papers selected; no verified fresh occult practitioner or machine-magick announcement.
